title: A field extension gives an fpqc singleton cover of spectra
statement: Let $k\subseteq K$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension]. The structure morphism $p:\operatorname{Spec}K\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism], and quasi-compact [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Consequently the one-member family $\{p\}$ is an fpqc covering of $\operatorname{Spec}k$ [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering].
